text:
alyssa_ops: Postmortem follow-up: recurring noisy pages from inference-gateway (mostly 403 bursts). Need owners for dedupe, thresholds, suppression windows, canary, and monthly churn audit. Quick plan in docs: https://internal/rems/inference-churn.

ben_oncall: I can take dedupe key + suppression window. Proposal: key = client_id:endpoint:hash(payload,6), suppression 180s. Will test in staging.

jia_sre: I'll own threshold/aggregation tuning and the monthly audit job. Plan: raise p95 threshold by 15% then monitor for 7 days, add a global p99 spike alert to avoid masking real regressions.

omar_dev: I'll implement the short hash util and add unit tests. Recommend including route and first 32 bytes of payload in hash input. Also can wire a small synthetic that replays the retry-loop pattern.

alert-bot: Incident 2026-04-02: inference-gateway high 403 rate -> 29 pages, peak 03:05 UTC.

kevin_prod: For rollout, suggested sequence: staging -> canary (5% traffic, 48h) -> gradual prod. Also I'll coordinate client outreach for top noisy clients.

ben_oncall: Draft alert snippet for review:
```
alert: InferenceGatewayAuthSpike
expr: sum(rate(gateway_responses_total{code="403"}[5m])) by (client_id, route) > 40
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: "/runbooks/inference-403.md"
```
Will add dedupe key to paging config as discussed.

jia_sre: LGTM. After canary, we'll compare pages/day and unique dedupe keys to quantify reduction. I'll add dashboards.

alyssa_ops: Owners + ETAs: ben (dedupe + suppression) 10 days, jia (thresholds + audit) 21 days, omar (hash util + synthetic) 5 days, kevin (client coord) 14 days. Please create GH issues tagged pm-followup/alert-tuning and add issue links to the tracker. Sync Friday 10:00 UTC.

omar_dev: PR for hash util in progress.

ben_oncall: Dedupe PR up for review, tests pass. Marking as WIP.

kevin_prod: Reached out to top 4 noisy clients, offering short-term guidance.

alyssa_ops: Thanks — if canary shows >60% drop in pages over 48h we consider short-term done and close follow-ups. Ping me if blocked.
